name: Fixture Endpoint
description: The E2E fixture for the Plugin Endpoint (#586): it declares the optional serve Plugin Permission and answers one whole request and one streamed request on its own path, so the @wf spec can prove routing, the grant gate, and that another Plugin's request never reaches it. The desktop listener and its socket are proven by the Rust tests in src-tauri/src/plugins/endpoint.rs. It is never shipped in a product bundle.
author: Maibuk
